Privacy charter

The information obtained on this site about you or a third party is necessary for us to process your request. We do not trade in customer files or confidential information, and we therefore undertake not to sell, trade or rent the data we collect.

Security

Encrypted payments on the Travelife.ma website are fully secure: the encryption technology we use is one of the most advanced systems available and guarantees the security of payments and transactions.

We receive and store any data you enter on our website or provide to us by any other means, including your credit card details (such as the card number, cardholder name and expiration date). We may also ask you for information about your preferences regarding address, phone number, etc.

You may choose not to provide us with data, but as a general rule, certain information about you is required to register as a member, purchase products and services, complete a profile, take part in a survey, contest or promotion, ask us a question or carry out any other transaction on our site.

Information collected

  • Your phone number, fax number or email address is required to contact you or send you your quotes or booking confirmations.
  • Your email address is used to subscribe you to our newsletter (news and special offers). You can unsubscribe from this newsletter at any time by simply replying to the email.

Links

To offer you a more complete service, this site allows you to visit other websites. When you click on these links, you are taken to another site: its privacy policy may differ from ours, so we recommend that you carefully read the information about how it processes data.

Call monitoring

Incoming and outgoing calls to our customer service may be recorded or monitored for quality control and staff training purposes. Call recordings will be kept for as long as reasonably necessary and will then be deleted. Any personal data obtained from you during the call will be processed in accordance with the provisions of the Privacy Charter.

Email communications

Travelife.ma helps you take advantage of travel-related opportunities on our website. We do this in particular by sending you emails containing information related to your travel interests.
